metadata.title: Ruma — Send dollars to your family's app
metadata.description: Send dollars to your family in Latin America, straight to their Yape, PIX or MercadoPago, and pay any QR with your balance.

hero.lead: It lands straight in their Yape, PIX or MercadoPago, even if they don’t have Ruma.
hero.cta_note: Runs in your browser. Nothing to install.

qr.heading: Pay with QR at the shop
qr.text: Scan the code and pay with your dollar balance. Works with QR codes from:

steps.title: Open it on the web
steps.body: Go to app.ruma.live on your phone or computer.

steps.title: Sign up with biometrics or email
steps.body: You choose how to get in: with your email or your phone’s biometrics.

steps.title: Add dollars from your bank
steps.body: From Brazil, Argentina, Mexico, Venezuela or Colombia.

steps.title: Send or pay
steps.body: To your family’s app, or a QR at the shop.

waitlist.heading: Hear what’s new
waitlist.text: We’ll write when new countries and the store apps land. We never share your email.
waitlist.thank_you: Done! We’ll write when there’s news.
waitlist.error: We could not save your email. Check your connection and try again.

beta_banner.message: Try the Ruma beta before it hits the Play Store.

beta.title: Try the Ruma beta
beta.subtitle: Get early access to the Android build before it hits the Play Store. Expect rough edges — your feedback shapes what ships.
beta.checksum_hint: Tap to copy. Verify after downloading.
beta.warning_body: It may contain bugs and unfinished features. Do not use it as your primary wallet. Only install if you understand the risks of self-custody software in development.
beta.install_step_1: Download the APK on your Android device.
beta.install_step_2: When prompted, allow installation from unknown sources for your browser.
beta.install_step_3: Open the file and follow the system prompts to install.
beta.install_step_4: Launch Ruma and create your account.
beta.feedback_body: Send us a note — every report helps.

methods.heading: How your family gets it
methods.sub: You send dollars and your family receives them in their currency, in the app they already use. They don’t need Ruma.
methods.question: Where is your family?

invest.heading: Investing in the app
invest.text: Soon you’ll be able to grow your dollars in Ruma, in the same place you send and pay.
